$james_gap_note: Two days carry this persona's point. Day 1 is the design pack's James: RHR 26% above baseline, no wrist temperature since Monday, so rule 1.3 (temperature AND RHR) is UNEVALUABLE and he is Partial, not falsely reassured (F5). Day 7 is the defect that survives: the same RHR with a temperature reading that IS present and normal, where 1.3 evaluates cleanly to FALSE. That leaves no warnings and no unevaluable Layer 1 row, and the app says 'in balance today' (F19). Candidate rule 1.4 would close it; F5b is a strict xfail that flips the day it is approved. Until plan v2 §3 the persona carried the present temperature on its crash state, which put the defect on day 1.
$no_cycle_note: James has no cycle data, which makes rules 2.1-2.4 UNEVALUABLE every single day — identically to a subject whose cycle data merely failed to sync. That is why app-states.json narrows the 'partial' predicate to Layer 1: counting all layers would make James permanently 'partial' and erase in_balance, taking F2 and F19 out of the demo.
